characterization_methods: Multiple internal reflection Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (MIR FT-IR)
evidence: Multiple internal reflection Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (MIR FT-IR) was used to observe the growth and removal of the SAM on the Ge surface. ... HR-TEM images were obtained with an electron kinetic energy of 300 keV. The elemental depth profile of each sample was obtained using medium-energy ion scattering (MEIS) spectroscopy. ... Static water contact angles were analyzed using a contact angle analyzer ... Capacitances were measured using a capacitance meter ... I –V measurements were performed using a parameter analyzer.
